Terms.pageSubtitle: Terms of use for SOL Logistics customer services.

general.title: 1. General Terms
general.body: By registering as a SOL Logistics customer, you agree to these terms. The information you provide must be accurate and legally accountable.

review.title: 2. Registration Review Process
review.body: Registrations are reviewed by our internal team. Account status remains Pending Review until approved. Admin accounts become active only after approval.

data.title: 3. Data Usage
data.body: Company data is used for logistics operations, billing, and service communications. We protect confidentiality according to company privacy policy.

service.title: 4. Services
service.body: After activation, customers may use the portal for bookings, shipments, invoices, and payments according to the applicable billing scheme.
